mapper.select:
/* INST_TYPE_SE_CD(기관 유형) => ( 1 여성가족부, 2 시도, 3 시군구, 4 중앙관리기관, 5 시도수행기관, 6 자원제공주체, 7 외부기관(기타) 8 시군구수행기관*/
SELECT /* isry.itgcm.ddln.monthDdln.mapper.MonthDdlnMapper.selectUntTaskwkInstList(단위업무 기관유형 기관명조회) 업무공통 유치훈*/ INST_NO AS INST_NO /* 기관번호*/ , INST_NM AS INST_NM /* 기관명*/ FROM ( SELECT X.INST_NO AS INST_NO /* 기관번호*/ , X.INST_NM AS INST_NM /* 기관명*/ , X.UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD AS UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD /* 단위업무구분코드*/ , X.INST_TYPE_SE_CD AS INST_TYPE_SE_CD /* 기관유형구분코드*/ , X.PIC_ENFSN_NO AS PIC_ENFSN_NO /* 담당자종사자번호*/ , X.PIC_NM_ENCPT AS PIC_NM_ENCPT /* 담당자명암호화*/ , X.CTPV_CD AS CTPV_CD /* 시도코드*/ FROM SAA000 X /* 통합기관*/ WHERE 1 = 1 AND X.APRV_YN = 'Y' /* 승인여부*/ AND X.DEL_YN = 'N' /* 삭제여부*/ AND X.UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD = #{UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD} /* 단위업무구분코드*/ AND ( X.UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD = 'U09' AND X.INST_TYPE_SE_CD IN ('9') ) /* 이주배경청소년지원센터*/ OR ( X.UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD = #{UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD} AND X.INST_TYPE_SE_CD IN ('5','8') ) /* 이주배경이외*/ ) ORDER BY CTPV_CD, INST_TYPE_SE_CD, INST_NM

/* isry.itgcm.ddln.monthDdln.mapper.MonthDdlnMapper.selectMonthDdlnList(월마감목록 조회) 업무공통 유치훈*/ DDNL_NO AS DDNL_NO /* 순번*/ , INST_NO AS INST_NO /* 기관번호*/ , UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD AS UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD /* 단위업무구분코드*/ , DDLN_YM AS DDLN_YM /* 마감연월*/ , DDLN_YN AS DDLN_YN /* 마감여부*/ , DDLN_APLCN_CRTR_SE_CD AS DDLN_APLCN_CRTR_SE_CD /* 마감적용기준구분코드*/ , REG_YMD AS REG_YMD /* 등록일자*/ , RGTR_NO AS RGTR_NO /* 등록자번호*/ , RGTR_NM_ENCPT AS RGTR_NM /* 등록자명*/ , REG_INST_NO AS REG_INST_NO /* 등록자기기관번호*/ , REG_INST_NM AS REG_INST_NM /* 등록자기관명*/ , CASE WHEN REG_INST_NO IS NOT NULL THEN '1' ELSE '0' END AS INST_NO_CHK /* 기관번호여부*/ , CASE WHEN (CURRENT_YEAR - DDLN_YEAR ) > 0 THEN '1' ELSE '0' END AS YEAR_CHK /* 지난마감연도확인*/ , CASE WHEN (CURRENT_MONTH - DDLN_MONTH) >= 2 THEN '1' ELSE '0' END AS MONTH_CHK /* 월확인*/ , CURRENT_YEAR , DDLN_YEAR , CURRENT_MONTH , DDLN_MONTH , CASE WHEN (CURRENT_YEAR - DDLN_YEAR ) = 0 THEN CASE WHEN (CURRENT_MONTH <> DDLN_MONTH AND ((CURRENT_MONTH - DDLN_MONTH) = 0 OR (CURRENT_MONTH - DDLN_MONTH) >= 2)) THEN '1' ELSE '0' END END AS CURRENT_MONTH_CHK , FRST_RGTR_ID AS FRST_RGTR_ID , FRST_REG_DT AS FRST_REG_DT , LAST_MDFR_ID AS LAST_MDFR_ID , LAST_MDFCN_DT AS LAST_MDFCN_DT
FROM( SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER( ORDER BY T1.DDLN_YM DESC ) AS DDNL_NO /* 월마감 순번*/ , T1.INST_NO AS INST_NO /* 기관번호*/ , T1.UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD AS UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD /* 단위업무구분코드*/ , T1.DDLN_YM AS DDLN_YM /* 마감연월*/ , SUBSTR(T1.DDLN_YM, 0, 4) AS DDLN_YEAR , SUBSTR(T1.DDLN_YM, 5, 2) AS DDLN_MONTH , T1.DDLN_YN AS DDLN_YN /* 마감여부*/ , T1.DDLN_APLCN_CRTR_SE_CD AS DDLN_APLCN_CRTR_SE_CD /* 마감적용기준구분코드*/ , T1.REG_YMD AS REG_YMD /* 등록일자*/ , T1.RGTR_NO AS RGTR_NO /* 등록자번호*/ , (SELECT C##RG.DEC_B64(X.FLNM_ENCPT) FROM SCA100 X WHERE X.ENFSN_NO = RGTR_NO) AS RGTR_NM_ENCPT /* 등록자명*/ , T1.REG_INST_NO AS REG_INST_NO /* 등록자기관번호*/ , (SELECT X.INST_NM FROM SAA000 X WHERE X.INST_NO = REG_INST_NO) AS REG_INST_NM /* 등록기관명*/ , (SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM SYSDATE) FROM DUAL) AS CURRENT_YEAR , (SELECT EXTRACT(MONTH FROM SYSDATE) FROM DUAL) AS CURRENT_MONTH , T1.FRST_RGTR_ID AS FRST_RGTR_ID /* 최초등록자아이디*/ , T1.FRST_REG_DT AS FRST_REG_DT /* 최초등록일시*/ , T1.LAST_MDFR_ID AS LAST_MDFR_ID /* 최종수정자아이디*/ , T1.LAST_MDFCN_DT AS LAST_MDFCN_DT /* 최종수정일시*/ FROM SEC330 T1 /* 사례관리마감*/ WHERE 1 = 1 AND (T1.UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD = #{UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD}) /* 단위업무구분코드*/ AND T1.DDLN_YM LIKE #{DDLN_YEAR} || '%' /* 마감연도*/ --AND T1.DDLN_YN = 'Y' /* 마감여부*/
AND T1.INST_NO = #{INST_NO} /* 기관번호*/
AND T1.REG_YMD = #{REG_YMD} /* 등록일자*/
AND T1.RGTR_NO = #{RGTR_NO} /* 등록자번호*/
AND T1.REG_INST_NO = #{REG_INST_NO} /* 등록자기관번호*/
)

SELECT /* isry.itgcm.ddln.monthDdln.mapper.MonthDdlnMapper.selectMonthDdlnPrd(기간 조회) 업무공통 유치훈*/ TWO_PREV_MONTH_LAST_DAY , TODAY , PREV_MONTH_LAST_DAY , CURRENT_MONTH_LAST_DAY , NEXT_MONTH_FIRST_DAY , CASE WHEN TODAY < CURRENT_MONTH_LAST_DAY THEN 'true' ELSE 'false' END DATECHK1 , CASE WHEN TODAY > PREV_MONTH_LAST_DAY THEN 'true' ELSE 'false' END DATECHK2 FROM ( SELECT LAST_DAY(ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE), -2)) AS TWO_PREV_MONTH_LAST_DAY /* 두달전 마지막일자*/ , TRUNC(SYSDATE) AS TODAY /* 오늘일자*/ , LAST_DAY(ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE), -1)) AS PREV_MONTH_LAST_DAY /* 전달 마지막일자*/ , LAST_DAY(TRUNC(SYSDATE)) AS CURRENT_MONTH_LAST_DAY /* 오늘일자 달 마지막일자*/ , ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'MM'), 1) AS NEXT_MONTH_FIRST_DAY /* 다음달 첫번째일자*/ FROM DUAL )

SELECT /* isry.itgcm.ddln.monthDdln.mapper.MonthDdlnMapper.selectBfeMonthDdlnList(전월마감 조회) 업무공통 유치훈*/ DDNL_NO AS DDNL_NO , INST_NO AS INST_NO , UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD AS UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD , DDLN_YM AS DDLN_YM , DDLN_YN AS DDLN_YN , DDLN_APLCN_CRTR_SE_CD AS DDLN_APLCN_CRTR_SE_CD , REG_YMD AS REG_YMD , RGTR_NO AS RGTR_NO , REG_INST_NO AS REG_INST_NO , CASE WHEN REG_INST_NO IS NOT NULL THEN '1' ELSE '0' END AS INST_NO_CHK , CASE WHEN (CURRENT_YEAR - DDLN_YEAR ) > 0 THEN '1' ELSE '0' END AS YEAR_CHK , CASE WHEN (CURRENT_MONTH - DDLN_MONTH) >= 2 THEN '1' ELSE '0' END AS MONTH_CHK , FRST_RGTR_ID AS FRST_RGTR_ID , FRST_REG_DT AS FRST_REG_DT , LAST_MDFR_ID AS LAST_MDFR_ID , LAST_MDFCN_DT AS LAST_MDFCN_DT FROM( SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER( ORDER BY T1.DDLN_YM DESC) AS DDNL_NO /* 전월마감 순번*/ , T1.INST_NO AS INST_NO /* 기관번호*/ , T1.UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD AS UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD /* 단위업무구분코드*/ , T1.DDLN_YM AS DDLN_YM /* 마감연월*/ , SUBSTR(T1.DDLN_YM, 0, 4) AS DDLN_YEAR , SUBSTR(T1.DDLN_YM, 4, 2) AS DDLN_MONTH , T1.DDLN_YN AS DDLN_YN /* 마감여부*/ , T1.DDLN_APLCN_CRTR_SE_CD AS DDLN_APLCN_CRTR_SE_CD /* 마감적용기준구분코드*/ , T1.REG_YMD AS REG_YMD /* 등록일자*/ , T1.RGTR_NO AS RGTR_NO /* 등록자번호*/ , T1.REG_INST_NO AS REG_INST_NO /* 등록자기관번호*/ , (SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM SYSDATE) FROM DUAL) AS CURRENT_YEAR , (SELECT EXTRACT(MONTH FROM SYSDATE) FROM DUAL) AS CURRENT_MONTH , T1.FRST_RGTR_ID AS FRST_RGTR_ID /* 최초등록자아이디*/ , T1.FRST_REG_DT AS FRST_REG_DT /* 최초등록일시*/ , T1.LAST_MDFR_ID AS LAST_MDFR_ID /* 최종수정자아이디*/ , T1.LAST_MDFCN_DT AS LAST_MDFCN_DT /* 최종수정일시*/ FROM SEC330 T1 WHERE 1 = 1 AND T1.UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD = #{UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD} /* 단위업무구분코드*/ AND T1.DDLN_YM = TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(SYSDATE, -1), 'YYYYMM') /* 마감연월*/ --AND T1.DDLN_YN = 'Y' /* 마감여부*/ )

SELECT /* isry.itgcm.ddln.monthDdln.mapper.MonthDdlnMapper.selectMonthDdlnCnt(월마감등록 확인) 업무공통 유치훈*/ COUNT(*) FROM SEC330 T1 /* 사례관리마감*/ WHERE 1 = 1 AND T1.INST_NO = #{INST_NO} /* 기관번호*/ AND T1.UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD = #{UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD} /* 단위업무구분코드*/ AND T1.DDLN_YM = #{DDLN_YM} /* 마감연월*/

SELECT /* isry.itgcm.ddln.monthDdln.mapper.MonthDdlnMapper.getSAA000InstNm(기관명 확인) 업무공통 유치훈*/ T1.INST_NM AS INST_NM FROM SAA000 T1 /* 기관*/ WHERE 1 = 1 AND T1.INST_NO = #{INST_NO} /* 기관번호*/ AND T1.UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD = #{UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD} /* 단위업무구분코드*/
mapper.insert: INSERT /* isry.itgcm.ddln.monthDdln.mapper.MonthDdlnMapper.insertMonthDdln(월마감 등록) 업무공통 유치훈*/ INTO SEC330 T1 ( T1.INST_NO /* 기관번호*/ , T1.UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD /* 단위업무구분코드*/ , T1.DDLN_YM /* 마감연월*/ , T1.DDLN_YN /* 마감여부*/ , T1.DDLN_APLCN_CRTR_SE_CD /* 마감적용기준구분코드*/ , T1.REG_YMD /* 등록일자*/ , T1.RGTR_NO /* 등록자번호*/ , T1.REG_INST_NO /* 등록자기관번호*/ , T1.FRST_RGTR_ID /* 최초등록자아이디*/ , T1.FRST_REG_DT /* 최초등록일시*/ , T1.LAST_MDFR_ID /* 최종수정자아이디*/ , T1.LAST_MDFCN_DT /* 최종수정일시*/ ) VALUES ( #{INST_NO} /* 기관번호*/ , #{UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD} /* 단위업무구분코드*/ , #{DDLN_YM} /* 마감연월*/ , NVL(#{DDLN_YN}, 'N') /* 마감여부*/ , #{DDLN_APLCN_CRTR_SE_CD} /* 마감적용기준구분코드*/ , NVL(#{REG_YMD}, TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD')) /* 등록일자*/ , #{RGTR_NO} /* 등록자번호*/ , #{REG_INST_NO} /* 등록자기관번호*/ , #{FRST_RGTR_ID} /* 최초등록자아이디*/ , SYSDATE /* 최초등록일시*/ , #{LAST_MDFR_ID} /* 최종수정자아이디*/ , SYSDATE /* 최종수정일시*/ )
mapper.update: UPDATE /* isry.itgcm.ddln.monthDdln.mapper.MonthDdlnMapper.updateMonthDdln(월마감 수정) 업무공통 유치훈*/ SEC330 T1 SET T1.DDLN_YM = #{DDLN_YM} /* 마감연월*/ , T1.DDLN_YN = #{DDLN_YN} /* 마감여부*/ , T1.DDLN_APLCN_CRTR_SE_CD = #{DDLN_APLCN_CRTR_SE_CD} /* 마감적용기준구분코드*/ , T1.REG_YMD = #{REG_YMD} /* 등록일자*/ , T1.RGTR_NO = #{RGTR_NO} /* 등록자번호*/ , T1.REG_INST_NO = #{REG_INST_NO} /* 등록자기관번호*/ , T1.LAST_MDFR_ID = #{LAST_MDFR_ID} /* 최종수정자아이디*/ , T1.LAST_MDFCN_DT = SYSDATE /* 최종수정일시*/ WHERE T1.INST_NO = #{INST_NO} /* 기관번호*/ AND T1.UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD = #{UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD} /* 단위업무구분코드*/ AND T1.DDLN_YM = #{DDLN_YM} /* 마감년월*/
mapper.select: SELECT /* isry.itgcm.ddln.monthDdln.mapper.MonthDdlnMapper.selectCaseMngDdlnCrtrInfo(사례관리 마감기준정보 조회) */ CASE WHEN T1.DDLN_APLCN_CRTR_SE_CD = '00' THEN TO_CHAR(LAST_DAY(TO_DATE(T1.DDLN_YM,'YYYYMM')),'YYYYMMDD') WHEN T1.DDLN_APLCN_CRTR_SE_CD = '99' THEN TO_CHAR(LAST_DAY(ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(T1.DDLN_YM,'YYYYMM'), 1)),'YYYYMMDD') ELSE TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(T1.DDLN_YM,'YYYYMM'), 1), 'YYYYMM') || T1.DDLN_APLCN_CRTR_SE_CD END AS DDLN_CRTR_YMD /* 마감기준년월 */ , T1.INST_NO AS INST_NO /* 기관번호 */ , T1.UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD AS UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD /* 단위업무구분코드 */ , T1.DDLN_YM AS DDLN_YM /* 마감년월 */ , T1.DDLN_YN AS DDLN_YN /* 마감여부 */ , T1.DDLN_APLCN_CRTR_SE_CD AS DDLN_APLCN_CRTR_SE_CD /* 마감적용기준구분코드 */ FROM SEC330 T1 /* 사례관리마감 */ WHERE T1.INST_NO = ( SELECT OGDP_INST_NO FROM SCA100 WHERE ENFSN_NO = ( SELECT CASE_PIC_NO FROM SEB150 WHERE CASE_MNG_NO = #{CASE_MNG_NO} AND CASE_MNG_ODRNO = #{CASE_MNG_ODRNO} AND PCHPRS_YN = 'Y' )) AND T1.UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD = #{UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD} AND T1.DDLN_YM = ( SELECT MAX(DDLN_YM) FROM SEC330 WHERE INST_NO = T1.INST_NO AND UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD = T1.UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD ) AND T1.DDLN_YN = 'Y'
